verdict.rationale: Morph is an API platform for models and agent tooling, not an analytics product. The closest match is Reflexes, which label conversation turns for signals like user frustration or stuck-in-a-loop. The Kimi K3 canary also compares Reflex results on production traffic before you switch, giving some AI-derived insight into your own agent data. missing for 10: an in-product insights or suggestions surface (dashboard or recommendations), AI-generated summaries or suggestions drawn from user data, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
